subject: Analyzing Habitat Selection of Animals from Telemetry Data

messages.author: eb6d1dacb2272114
messages.subject: Analyzing Habitat Selection of Animals from Telemetry Data
parts:
Dear all,

We are excited to offer our online course, Analyzing Habitat Selection of Animals from Telemetry Data, scheduled for 20th to 23rd April 2026.

 

This course is ideal for researchers and graduate students with experience in animal movement analysis using R. Building on foundational knowledge, you will learn to fit and interpret Habitat Selection Functions (HSFs/RSFs) and Step Selection Functions (SSFs), explore model extensions, validation methods, and integrate behavioral states via Hidden Markov Models (HMMs).

 

 

Participants will engage in hands-on coding sessions using example datasets, with the opportunity to work on their own telemetry data.

 

Sessions run daily from 14:00 to 18:00 Berlin time.

 

For more information and to register, please visit our website: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/telemetry/

 

If you are interested in an introduction to Animal Movement in R, please have a look at: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/mve-r/

 

Best regards,

Carlo

--------------------

Carlo Pecoraro, Ph.D


Physalia-courses DIRECTOR
